title: Heart failure and atrial fibrillation prediction from non-gated chest CT scans using AI-based cardiac chamber volumetry: an AI-CVD study within the multi-ethnic study of atherosclerosis (MESA).
summary:
BACKGROUND: We previously demonstrated that AI-derived cardiac chamber volumetry in ECG-gated CT scans predicts atrial fibrillation (AF) and heart failure (HF). Since most chest CTs are non-gated, and the American Heart Association recently highlighted their value for opportunistic cardiovascular risk assessment using AI-based coronary artery calcium scoring, we extended this concept to evaluate whether AI-derived chamber volumetry from non-gated CTs can reliably predict HF and AF.s.

METHODS: We compared AI-derived chamber volumetry from non-gated and ECG-gated chest CTs in 2053 Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA) Exam 5 participants using mean and standard-deviation of absolute differences, intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC), and Cohen's κ. Variability between paired ECG-gated scans was determined by analyzing scans acquired 2 min apart in 5749 MESA Exam 1 participants. Predictive performance for incident HF and AF was compared using cumulative incidence curves, age- and sex-adjusted C-indices, and non-inferiority testing (δ=0.05).

RESULTS: Non-gated scans demonstrated excellent overall agreement with ECG-gated scans, with comparable performance for detecting cardiac chamber enlargement (98.8-99.2%, κ=0.76-0.84), relative to agreement observed between paired ECG-gated scans (98.6-98.9%, κ=0.72-0.77). Cumulative incidence curves for HF and AF stratified by quartiles showed substantial overlap. Age- and sex-adjusted C-indices were comparable for left atrial volume (0.75 vs 0.74, p = 0.001, non-inferiority p < 0.001), ventricular volume (both 0.77, p = 0.97, non-inferiority p < 0.001), and ventricular ratio (both 0.74, p = 0.57, non-inferiority p < 0.001) in predicting AF and HF.

CONCLUSION: AI-based evaluation of non-gated chest CT may provide reliable cardiac chamber volumetry and cardiovascular outcome prediction, enabling opportunistic screening for HF and AF risk.

AI.tldr: 在 MESA 研究的 2053 名受试者中，基于非门控胸部 CT 的 AI 心腔容积测量与心电门控 CT 高度一致，预测新发心衰与房颤的 C 指数为 0.74–0.77，非劣效检验成立。
AI.motivation: 研究团队此前已证实，心电门控 CT 的 AI 心腔容积测量可预测房颤（AF）与心衰（HF），但临床上绝大多数胸部 CT 为非门控采集，既往证据能否外推存疑。美国心脏协会（AHA）近期强调，非门控 CT 结合 AI 冠脉钙化评分可用于机会性心血管风险评估，因此有必要验证非门控 CT 的心腔容积测量是否同样可靠、是否具备结局预测价值。
AI.method: 基于多族裔动脉粥样硬化研究（MESA）的一致性分析与预后分析。一致性分析纳入 Exam 5 的 2053 名受试者，比较非门控与心电门控胸部 CT 的 AI 心腔容积测量，采用绝对差值的均值与标准差、组内相关系数（ICC）及 Cohen's κ 评价；并以 Exam 1 中 5749 名受试者间隔 2 分钟重复采集的配对心电门控扫描作为扫描间变异度的参照。预后终点为新发 HF 与 AF，统计方法包括累积发病率曲线、年龄与性别校正 C 指数以及非劣效检验（δ=0.05）。
AI.result: 非门控扫描与心电门控扫描总体一致性优秀，检出心腔扩大的符合率为 98.8%–99.2%（κ=0.76–0.84），与配对门控扫描之间的一致性（98.6%–98.9%，κ=0.72–0.77）相当。按心腔容积四分位分层的 HF 与 AF 累积发病率曲线明显重叠。年龄与性别校正 C 指数显示，左房容积为 0.75 vs 0.74（p=0.001，非劣效 p<0.001），心室容积两者均为 0.77（p=0.97，非劣效 p<0.001），心室比值两者均为 0.74（p=0.57，非劣效 p<0.001）；摘要未逐一区分上述数值对应 AF 还是 HF。具体 ICC 与绝对差值数值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: AI 辅助的非门控胸部 CT 心腔容积测量结果可靠，对 HF 与 AF 的预测能力不劣于心电门控 CT，支持在常规胸部 CT 中开展机会性 HF/AF 风险筛查。局限在于该研究为多族裔观察性队列内的分析，缺乏外部验证与前瞻性数据，且从风险识别到临床干预的路径（如何报告、如何随访与治疗）尚未确定，距改变电生理实践仍有距离。

title: GLP-1 receptor agonist therapy and incident atrial fibrillation in non-diabetic adults with obesity and chronic kidney disease: a propensity matched cohort study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Obesity and chronic kidney disease (CKD) are potent risk factors for atrial fibrillation (AF), yet whether GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) prevent incident AF in non-diabetic adults with obesity and CKD is unexamined. We assessed whether GLP-1RA therapy reduces 1-year AF incidence in this cardiorenal phenotype.

METHODS: Using the TriNetX US Collaborative Network (66 healthcare organizations), we conducted a retrospective target trial emulation of non-diabetic adults aged 18 or older with obesity and CKD stages 3-5 diagnosed 2021-2024. Patients receiving semaglutide, liraglutide, or tirzepatide (n = 10,985) were compared with unexposed patients (n = 94,527). After propensity score matching, 7326 patients remained per cohort. The primary outcome was incident AF at 1 year; secondary outcomes included AF subtypes, ventricular tachyarrhythmias, and all-cause hospitalization. Cox models generated hazard ratios (HRs); sensitivity analyses extended follow-up to 2-3 years with landmark analyses.

RESULTS: At 1 year, GLP-1RA use was associated with significantly lower incident AF (1.63% vs. 2.62%; HR 0.655, 95% CI 0.508-0.844; p = 0.001), a 34.5% relative risk reduction. Reductions were consistent for paroxysmal (HR 0.586), persistent (HR 0.482), and longstanding persistent AF (HR 0.527; all p < 0.05); permanent AF was non-significant at 1 year. Ventricular tachyarrhythmias (HR 0.556; p = 0.002) and hospitalization (HR 0.668; p < 0.001) were also significantly reduced. Benefits persisted across 2- and 3-year follow-up and remained consistent in landmark analyses.

CONCLUSIONS: In non-diabetic adults with obesity and CKD, GLP-1RA therapy was associated with significant, durable reductions in incident AF, ventricular arrhythmias, and hospitalization. These findings are consistent with a possible cardiorenal benefit and support prioritizing this phenotype for dedicated randomized trials.

AI.tldr: 在非糖尿病肥胖合并CKD 3-5期成人中，GLP-1受体激动剂治疗与1年新发房颤风险显著降低相关（1.63% vs 2.62%，HR 0.655）。
AI.motivation: 肥胖和慢性肾脏病（CKD）均为房颤的重要危险因素，但GLP-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RA）能否在这一“心肾表型”的非糖尿病人群中预防新发房颤，此前尚无研究。本研究旨在评估GLP-1RA治疗能否降低该人群1年房颤发生率。
AI.method: 基于TriNetX美国协作网络（66家医疗机构）的回顾性目标试验模拟研究，纳入2021-2024年诊断的18岁及以上、非糖尿病、肥胖合并CKD 3-5期成人。暴露组接受司美格鲁肽、利拉鲁肽或替尔泊肽（n=10,985），对照组为未暴露者（n=94,527）；倾向性评分匹配后每组各7326例。主要终点为1年新发房颤；次要终点包括房颤亚型、室性快速性心律失常及全因住院。采用Cox模型计算风险比（HR），敏感性分析将随访延长至2-3年并进行landmark分析。
AI.result: 1年时，GLP-1RA组新发房颤显著低于对照组（1.63% vs 2.62%；HR 0.655，95%CI 0.508-0.844；p=0.001），相对风险下降34.5%。阵发性（HR 0.586）、持续性（HR 0.482）和长程持续性房颤（HR 0.527）均一致降低（均p<0.05）；永久性房颤在1年时差异无统计学意义。室性快速性心律失常（HR 0.556；p=0.002）和住院（HR 0.668；p<0.001）亦显著减少。获益在2年和3年随访中持续存在，landmark分析结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 在非糖尿病肥胖合并CKD成人中，GLP-1RA治疗与1年新发房颤、室性心律失常及住院的显著且持久下降相关，提示可能存在心肾获益。本研究为回顾性观察性设计，存在残余混杂可能，结果支持将该表型人群优先纳入专门的随机对照试验加以验证。

title: Investigating Factors Associated with the Occurrence of Atrial Fibrillation after Non-cardiothoracic Surgery.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Although the occurrence of atrial fibrillation (AF) after cardiac and thoracic surgery is common and leads to serious complications such as patients' vital organ dysfunction, pulmonary edema, myocardial infarction, and death, evidence about the occurrence and risk factors associated with post-operative atrial fibrillation (POAF) as new AF immediately after non-cardiac thoracic surgery is limited. Therefore, the present study aimed at investigating the factors related to the occurrence of POAF after non-cardiothoracic surgery.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: The present retrospective study was conducted on 272 patients undergoing non-cardiothoracic surgeries during 2007-2020. Patients' basic and clinical information including age, sex, BMI, addiction, comorbidities, history of non-cardiac thoracic surgery, history of cardiac surgery, history of chronic kidney disease (CKD), history of ischemic heart disease (IHD), history of heart failure (HF), valvular heart disease (VHD), and the occurrence or non-occurrence of POAF was extracted from their records and then documented.

RESULTS: In the present study, 48.1% and 51.9% of patients were with and without POAF, respectively. Risk factors associated with increasing the odds of POAF occurrence included age (OR = 1.094), anemia (OR = 3.947), IHD (OR = 4.23), CKD (OR = 4.765), VHD (OR = 4.781), pulmonary diseases (OR = 7.828), hypertension (HTN) (OR = 8.336), HF (OR = 11.790), and post-thoracic surgery (OR = 49.072) (P-value < 0.05).

CONCLUSION: According to the results of the present study, aging, comorbidities (i.e., anemia, pulmonary diseases, HTN, and CKD), heart diseases (i.e., IHD, VHD, and HF), and post-thoracic surgery were among the most significant risk factors associated with the increased occurrence of POAF.

AI.tldr: 单中心272例非心胸外科手术回顾性队列中，术后房颤（POAF）发生率高达48.1%，既往胸部手术、心衰、高血压、肺部疾病及瓣膜病是最强的相关因素。
AI.motivation: 心脏与胸科手术后房颤常见，可导致重要脏器功能不全、肺水肿、心肌梗死甚至死亡，但关于非心胸外科手术后新发房颤（POAF）的发生率及其危险因素证据有限，本研究旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入2007—2020年接受非心胸外科手术的患者272例；从病历中提取年龄、性别、BMI、成瘾史、合并症（贫血、高血压、慢性肾脏病CKD、缺血性心脏病IHD、心力衰竭HF、瓣膜性心脏病VHD、肺部疾病）、非心脏胸部手术史、心脏手术史及POAF发生情况；以是否发生POAF为终点，采用回归分析估计各因素的比值比（OR），摘要未报告具体统计模型与置信区间。
AI.result: POAF组占48.1%，无POAF组占51.9%。与POAF风险升高相关的因素包括：年龄（OR=1.094）、贫血（OR=3.947）、IHD（OR=4.23）、CKD（OR=4.765）、VHD（OR=4.781）、肺部疾病（OR=7.828）、高血压（OR=8.336）、HF（OR=11.790）、胸部手术后（OR=49.072），均P<0.05；摘要未报告各OR的95%置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 衰老、合并症（贫血、肺部疾病、高血压、CKD）、心脏疾病（IHD、VHD、HF）及既往胸部手术均与POAF发生增加显著相关，提示对具备上述特征的非心胸外科手术患者应加强围术期心律监测与术前风险分层；但本研究为单中心回顾性设计、样本量有限、仅报告OR而未报告置信区间，且未说明房颤的判定与随访方式，结论需前瞻性多中心研究验证。

title: Initiation of Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonist Therapy and Lifestyle Modifications for Morbid Obesity in a Patient With Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation, Severe Osteoarthritis, and Obstructive Sleep Apnea: A Case Report.
summary: This case report describes a 57-year-old man with morbid obesity, paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, and severe knee osteoarthritis. We discuss the successful optimization of his metabolic and orthopedic risks through the initiation of a glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist in conjunction with a structured lifestyle modification plan. This case demonstrates the measurable benefit of combining advanced pharmacotherapy with targeted behavioral interventions to manage complex, obesity-related comorbidities. Through the course of a 12-month monitoring period, this patient shifted his body mass index (BMI) from stage 2 to stage 1 obesity, moved his blood pressure to a healthier range, and achieved measurable improvements in his lipid profile.

AI.tldr: 一例57岁重度肥胖合并阵发性房颤、重度膝骨关节炎及阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停的患者，在启动GLP-1受体激动剂并配合结构化生活方式干预12个月后，BMI由2级肥胖降至1级肥胖，血压与血脂谱亦改善。
AI.motivation: 肥胖是阵发性房颤、阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停及膝骨关节炎的共同可调控危险因素，减重有望同时降低房颤负荷与骨科、代谢风险；但GLP-1受体激动剂等新型减重药物与结构化生活方式干预联合应用于此类多重共病人群的实际获益，既往证据多为单一疾病终点，缺乏个案层面的整合观察。
AI.method: 个案报告（单例）。对象为57岁男性，患重度肥胖、阵发性房颤及重度膝骨关节炎，摘要提及合并阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停。干预为启动GLP-1受体激动剂并联合结构化生活方式调整方案。观察期12个月，观察指标包括BMI分级变化、血压水平及血脂谱。摘要未报告具体用药剂量、房颤负荷监测方式、睡眠呼吸暂停指标及统计方法。
AI.result: 12个月随访期内，患者BMI由2级肥胖降至1级肥胖，血压移至更健康范围，血脂谱获得可测量的改善。摘要未报告BMI、血压、血脂的具体数值及变化幅度，未报告95%置信区间或P值，亦未报告房颤发作频率、消融或抗心律失常药物使用变化及骨关节炎症状评分。
AI.conclusion: 该个案提示，GLP-1受体激动剂联合结构化生活方式干预可在12个月内改善重度肥胖合并阵发性房颤患者的多项代谢指标，为以体重管理为核心的房颤上游治疗提供了实践参考。但作为单例报告，缺乏对照与客观房颤终点，结果不能外推，尚需前瞻性研究验证其对房颤复发与心律失常负荷的真实影响。

title: Totally Thoracoscopic Atrial Fibrillation Ablation With the Gemini S Bipolar Clamp: A Single-Center Descriptive Cohort Study of 1-Year Rhythm, Safety, and Quality-of-Life Outcomes.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Outcome data for the Gemini S bipolar radiofrequency clamp are almost absent; the only indexed report being a three-patient case series. We describe 1-year outcomes in a consecutive cohort.

METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed all consecutive patients treated with the Gemini S clamp between January 2021 and August 2024. Epicardial box isolation was combined with left atrial appendage (LAA) exclusion; completeness was confirmed by entry and exit block on epicardial three-dimensional mapping. The primary outcome was freedom from AF recurrence at 12 months, on and off antiarrhythmic drugs (AADs) after a 90-day blanking period.

RESULTS: Twenty-three patients were included (mean age 64.4 ± 8.0 years; 82.6% male). AF was paroxysmal in 34.8%, persistent in 26.1%, and long-standing persistent in 39.1%; 60.9% had prior catheter ablation and 69.6% had failed or were intolerant to a Class I or III agent. A complete block-verified box lesion was achieved in 95.7% and LAA exclusion in 91.3%. Three patients (13.0%) required conversion to sternotomy for bleeding, exceeding larger series. There was no death, stroke, phrenic nerve palsy, or pacemaker implantation. At 1 year, 87.0% (95% CI 67.9-95.5) were in sinus rhythm, all off Class I/III AADs.

CONCLUSIONS: Sinus rhythm was achieved in 87.0% of patients at 1 year. As the largest reported experience with this device, the series provides device-level evidence where little existed, but it is descriptive, not powered for comparison, and the conversion rate needs confirmation.

AI.tldr: 单中心23例连续病例显示，使用Gemini S双极射频钳行全胸腔镜心外膜盒式隔离联合左心耳排除，1年87.0%维持窦性心律且全部停用I/III类抗心律失常药，但13.0%因出血中转开胸。
AI.motivation: Gemini S双极射频钳用于心外膜房颤消融的结局数据几乎缺失，此前仅有3例病例系列报告，缺乏较大样本的节律、安全性和生活质量证据，临床难以评估该器械的实际价值。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性描述性队列研究，连续纳入2021年1月至2024年8月接受Gemini S钳治疗的全部患者共23例（平均年龄64.4±8.0岁，男性82.6%）；阵发性AF 34.8%、持续性26.1%、长程持续性39.1%，60.9%有既往导管消融史，69.6%曾使用I/III类抗心律失常药失败或不耐受。术式为全胸腔镜心外膜盒式隔离联合左心耳（LAA）排除，以心外膜三维电解剖标测的传入与传出阻滞确认隔离完整性。主要终点为90天空白期后12个月无AF复发（无论是否服用抗心律失常药）。研究为描述性，未设对照、未做效能计算。
AI.result: 阻断验证的完整盒式病变率达95.7%，左心耳排除率91.3%。3例（13.0%）因出血中转胸骨切开，作者指出该比例高于更大样本的 series，且未报告其他比较性统计量。无死亡、卒中、膈神经麻痹或起搏器植入。1年时87.0%（95%CI 67.9–95.5）维持窦性心律，且全部停用I/III类抗心律失常药。生活质量结局摘要未报告具体数据。
AI.conclusion: 作为该器械目前最大规模的使用经验，本研究报告1年窦性心律率达87.0%，在既往证据极少的情况下提供了器械层面的初步数据。但研究为描述性、样本量小、无对照组，13.0%的中转开胸率高于其他较大样本系列，需进一步验证；对电生理实践而言，该结果支持在特定人群（含既往导管消融失败的长程持续性AF）中考虑全胸腔镜心外膜消融，但安全性与疗效仍需前瞻性对照研究确认。

title: Localized bigeminal activity in the left atrial posterior wall preceding atrial fibrillation initiation.
summary:
Bigeminal activity of the pulmonary veins is considered an indicator of arrhythmogenic triggers of atrial fibrillation (AF). However, few reports have described localized bigeminal activity originating from non-pulmonary vein regions. We observed the phenomenon of local bigeminal activities, which did not develop into premature atrial contraction, in a restricted area of left atrial posterior wall (LAPW), preceding the initiation of the AF. Radiofrequency ablation targeting the site of these bigeminal activities transiently suppressed AF, and subsequent linear ablation connecting the site to the adjacent low-voltage region resulted in durable elimination of AF. The spatial relationship between the localized activity and the low-voltage substrate suggests that conduction abnormalities within diseased atrial myocardium may have contributed to the observed phenomenon. This case highlights the potential role of localized electrical activity arising near a low-voltage substrate of the LAPW in AF initiation and may provide insights into the electrophysiological mechanisms of non-pulmonary vein triggers.

LEARNING OBJECTIVE: Left atrial posterior wall (LAPW) is known to be one of the non-pulmonary vein (PV) origins triggering atrial fibrillation (AF). While bigeminal activity originating from PVs or superior vena cava has been associated with arrhythmogenic triggers, similar activity originating from non-PV origin, such as LAPW, has rarely been described. This case indicates that localized bigeminal activity occurring near a low-voltage substrate of the LAPW may precede AF initiation and provides new insights into non-PV arrhythmogenic substrates as the target of ablation.

AI.tldr: 本例报道左心房后壁局限区域出现未下传为房性期前收缩的成对电活动，先于房颤发作，提示非肺静脉起源的局部电活动可驱动房颤。
AI.motivation: 肺静脉内的成对（二联）电活动被视为房颤致心律失常触发的标志，而关于非肺静脉区域（如左心房后壁）出现类似局限成对电活动的报道极少，此类非肺静脉触发灶的电生理机制与消融策略尚不明确。
AI.method: 单例病例报告（J Cardiol Cases）。在房颤发作前对左心房后壁进行电生理标测，观察到局限区域内出现未发展为房性期前收缩的成对电活动；先对该成对电活动位点行射频消融，随后行线性消融将该位点与毗邻低电压区连接。终点为房颤的即刻抑制与长期消除情况，并分析局部电活动与低电压基质之间的空间关系。摘要未报告样本量以外的定量数据与随访时程。
AI.result: 针对成对电活动位点的射频消融仅一过性抑制房颤；追加连接该位点与毗邻低电压区的线性消融后，房颤获得持久消除。摘要未报告具体的电生理参数、消融时间、随访时长及统计学检验结果。
AI.conclusion: 左心房后壁低电压基质附近出现的局限成对电活动可能是非肺静脉性房颤触发灶，提示病变心房肌内的传导异常参与其发生；对此类位点单纯行点消融可能不足，需联合基质相关的线性消融。本结果来自单例观察，尚不能推广，需更多病例与系统研究验证。

title: Successful superior vena cava isolation using point-by-point cryothermal ablation after failed radiofrequency ablation.
summary:
Pulmonary vein isolation is the cornerstone of catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation (AF), but non-pulmonary vein (non-PV) triggers such as the superior vena cava (SVC) also play an important role. Electrical isolation of the SVC (SVCI) can be limited by anatomical complexity and the risk of phrenic nerve or sinus node injury, particularly with radiofrequency or cryoballoon techniques. We report a 76-year-old woman with recurrent paroxysmal AF after cryoballoon pulmonary vein isolation. During repeat ablation, AF was initially induced from the left atrial posterior wall and successfully treated with radiofrequency ablation. Subsequent provocation revealed AF triggers from the SVC. Despite careful radiofrequency ablation under phrenic nerve pacing, complete SVCI could not be achieved. Point-by-point cryothermal ablation was then performed under continuous phrenic nerve monitoring, resulting in successful SVCI without complications. This case suggests that focal cryothermal ablation may be a practical and safer alternative when SVCI cannot be achieved with radiofrequency energy.

LEARNING OBJECTIVE: To understand that superior vena cava isolation (SVCI) may be challenging with radiofrequency ablation due to anatomical complexity and safety limitations related to phrenic nerve injury. This case highlights point-by-point cryothermal ablation as a feasible alternative strategy, enabling stable catheter contact, precise lesion delivery, and continuous phrenic nerve monitoring, particularly in regions where point-by-point pulsed-field ablation is not yet available.

AI.tldr: 一例 76 岁女性在冷冻球囊肺静脉隔离后复发阵发性 AF；再次消融时，射频能量无法完成上腔静脉隔离，改用逐点冷冻消融并在连续膈神经监测下成功完成 SVCI，且无并发症。
AI.motivation: 肺静脉隔离是 AF 导管消融的基石，但上腔静脉等非肺静脉触发灶同样在 AF 中起重要作用。SVCI 受解剖复杂性和膈神经、窦房结损伤风险的限制，采用射频或冷冻球囊技术时尤为困难，因此射频消融失败后可供选择的替代能量方式有限；该病例旨在探索这类情形下的可行策略。
AI.method: 单例病例报告（样本量 n=1）。对象为 76 岁女性，冷冻球囊肺静脉隔离后复发的阵发性 AF 患者。再次消融时先行诱发测试，对左心房后壁来源的 AF 触发灶行射频消融；随后诱发显示 SVC 触发灶，在膈神经起搏保护下尝试射频消融，未能实现完全 SVCI，遂改为逐点冷冻消融并在连续膈神经监测下操作。终点为 SVCI 是否达成（摘要未具体说明是否采用传入/传出阻滞判定）及围术期并发症；摘要未报告统计方法、消融点数、手术与透视时间及随访方案。
AI.result: 左心房后壁触发灶经射频消融后消失；SVC 触发灶经诱发证实。在膈神经起搏下谨慎行射频消融，仍未达到完全 SVCI；改用逐点冷冻消融并在连续膈神经监测下完成，成功实现 SVCI，未发生并发症，即摘要未报告膈神经麻痹或窦房结损伤。其他量化指标（如消融时间、成功率数据、随访期内 AF 复发率）摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 该病例提示，当射频能量难以实现 SVCI 时，逐点冷冻消融可作为一种可行且可能更安全的替代方式：其导管贴靠稳定、可精准释放损伤，且能与连续膈神经监测兼容，尤其适用于逐点脉冲场消融尚不可及的中心。局限性在于仅为单例经验，缺乏长期无 AF 复发证据与对照数据，不宜据此改变常规实践。

title: Sinus arrest during right pulmonary vein isolation related to right sinus node artery injury: a case report.
summary:
A 50-year-old man with long-standing persistent atrial fibrillation received radiofrequency catheter ablation after electrical cardioversion. The second radiofrequency application on anterior antrum of the right superior pulmonary vein induced sinus arrest following a sinus cycle length prolongation. Sinus arrest persisted. Right ventricular pacing was required for 3 min until a sinus rhythm was restored. Preprocedural contrast-enhanced computed tomography revealed that the ablation site was near the right sinus node artery (SNA). Retrospective analysis during catheter ablation confirmed a direct anatomical relationship between the ablation site and the right SNA. In the present case, rapid recovery without coronary intervention suggests a transient and reversible mechanism, such as SNA spasm. This case highlights the importance of preprocedural anatomical assessment of the SNA and performing ablation under sinus rhythm, which may facilitate early recognition of sinus node dysfunction and help prevent irreversible injury.

LEARNING OBJECTIVE: A right sinus node artery might be close to the right superior pulmonary vein and can be affected by right pulmonary vein isolation. In cases of persistent atrial fibrillation, performing ablation under sinus rhythm allows immediate recognition of sinus node dysfunction and may help prevent irreversible sinus node injury.

AI.tldr: 长程持续性房颤患者右侧上肺静脉前庭射频消融时疑因右窦房结动脉痉挛出现窦性停搏，右室起搏3分钟后恢复，提示术前评估该动脉并在窦性心律下消融有助于早期识别损伤。
AI.motivation: 右肺静脉隔离是房颤消融的重要组成部分，但右侧上肺静脉前庭与右窦房结动脉解剖邻近，消融相关窦房结动脉损伤及窦性停搏的识别与预防证据有限；持续性房颤常在房颤律下消融，难以实时发现窦房结功能异常。
AI.method: 本文为个案报道。对象为50岁男性长程持续性房颤患者，电复律后接受射频导管消融；在右侧上肺静脉前庭前部行第二次射频放电时出现窦性周期延长后窦性停搏，需右室起搏3分钟至窦律恢复。术前增强CT评估消融部位与右窦房结动脉关系，并回顾性分析确认解剖邻近。摘要未报告样本量统计比较或终点统计方法。
AI.result: 第二次放电后先出现窦性周期延长，随后窦性停搏并持续，右室起搏3分钟后恢复窦律；术前增强CT显示消融部位邻近右窦房结动脉，回顾性分析确认消融部位与右窦房结动脉存在直接解剖关系；未行冠状动脉介入而快速恢复，提示短暂可逆机制如窦房结动脉痉挛。摘要未报告具体心率、窦性周期长度数值及随访时间。
AI.conclusion: 右窦房结动脉可邻近右侧上肺静脉，右肺静脉隔离可能累及其导致窦性停搏；术前增强CT解剖评估并在窦性心律下消融有助于早期识别窦房结功能障碍、避免不可逆损伤。作为单例个案，因果关系与发生率尚不能确定，需更多病例和影像-电生理研究验证。

title: Absence of arrhythmogenic effects in cAMP subcellular compartments supports PDE8 as a target in atrial fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Targeting Phosphodiesterase 8B (PDE8B) has been proposed as a strategy to restore L-type Ca2+ current (ICa,L) in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF). However, the effects of total PDE8 inhibition on other Ca2+ handling or 3',5'-cyclic adenosine monophosphate (cAMP) nanodomains have not been assessed and thus the potential proarrhythmic consequences are still undetermined.

OBJECTIVE: The aim of this study was to assess whether PDE8 contributes to the regulation of cAMP signaling in other Ca2+ handling-related compartments and to sarcoplasmic reticulum Ca2+ release-mediated arrhythmogenic events.

RESULTS: Fluorescence resonance energy transfer (FRET) live-cell imaging, confocal Ca2+ imaging and co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) were performed in atrial myocytes and tissues allocated across experimental assays from a total cumulative cohort of 141 patients with or without AF (sinus rhythm, Ctl). cAMP levels were not significantly increased upon non-isoform-selective total PDE8 inhibition in the cytosol, in ryanodine receptor 2 (RyR2) or in the sarcomere nanodomains, troponin I (TpnI) and myosin binding protein C (MyBP-C). Consistently, no significant changes in the frequency of arrhythmogenic Ca2+ sparks or Ca2+ waves after total PDE8 inhibitor application were detected.

CONCLUSION: These results suggest that PDE8 inhibition promotes a compartment-specific regulation of cAMP signaling that exclusively affects the L-type Ca2+ channel in human atrial myocytes. Therefore, PDE8 inhibition can be used to restore ICa,L in patients with AF, without promoting spontaneous arrhythmogenic Ca2+ releases in isolated human atrial myocytes.

AI.tldr: 在141例房颤与窦律患者的心房肌细胞中，非亚型选择性PDE8抑制未增加胞质、RyR2及肌节纳米域cAMP，也未诱发致心律失常性钙火花或钙波，支持PDE8作为房颤治疗靶点。
AI.motivation: 房颤患者存在L型钙电流（ICa,L）降低，抑制PDE8B被提出可恢复ICa,L；但总PDE8抑制是否影响其他钙处理相关cAMP纳米域、是否带来致心律失常风险尚不明确。
AI.method: 研究采用人房肌细胞与组织，来自含房颤和窦律对照的累计141例患者队列；使用FRET活细胞成像检测胞质、RyR2、肌节纳米域TpnI和MyBP-C的cAMP水平，共聚焦钙成像检测钙火花/钙波，Co-IP检测蛋白相互作用；干预为非亚型选择性总PDE8抑制；摘要未报告具体统计方法与效应量。
AI.result: 总PDE8抑制后，胞质、RyR2、TpnI及MyBP-C纳米域的cAMP水平均未见显著升高；致心律失常性钙火花和钙波频率亦无显著变化；摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: 结果提示PDE8抑制在人房肌细胞中呈区室特异性cAMP调控，主要影响L型钙通道，可在房颤中恢复ICa,L而不促进离体人房肌细胞的自发性致心律失常性钙释放；但证据限于离体细胞/组织，尚缺乏在体心律失常终点和临床结局验证。

title: Recurrent Supraventricular Tachycardia Triggered by Tea Consumption in a Postoperative Adolescent Female: A Case Report.
summary: Supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) in adolescents may be triggered by physiological stress or caffeine. We report a 16-year-old girl who complained of palpitations, dyspnea, and regular tachycardia (170 beats/min) after tea intake. ECG showed SVT and intravenous adenosine restored sinus rhythm. Recognizing dietary stimulants as potential precipitants of SVT is important.

AI.tldr: 16岁术后女性饮茶后反复出现室上性心动过速（心率170次/分），静脉腺苷转复为窦性心律，提示茶等含咖啡因膳食因素可作为青少年SVT的可识别诱因。
AI.motivation: 青少年室上性心动过速（SVT）可由生理应激或咖啡因诱发，但临床病史采集常集中于心悸发作特点与结构性心脏病，对茶饮等含咖啡因膳食诱因的询问不足，相关病例报道亦少，可能导致诱因识别与患者教育缺位。
AI.method: 个案报道（单例，无对照组）。研究对象为一名16岁女性，处于术后状态；因饮茶后出现心悸、呼吸困难及规则心动过速就诊。心电图证实为SVT，心率170次/分；干预为静脉注射腺苷。观察指标为心律转复及症状缓解情况；摘要未报告茶饮种类与摄入量、发作持续时间、电生理检查结果及随访数据，亦未涉及统计学检验。
AI.result: 心电图显示SVT，心室率170次/分；静脉给予腺苷后恢复窦性心律，心悸、呼吸困难症状随之缓解。摘要未报告腺苷剂量、转复所需时间、复发次数及随访期内是否再发。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示应将茶、咖啡等含咖啡因膳食兴奋剂纳入青少年SVT的诱因评估与患者教育，减少可避免的发作。局限性为单例观察，无法确立饮茶与SVT发作的因果关系，缺乏诱发试验、电生理检查及长期随访证据，结论外推需谨慎。

title: Stellate ganglion block for ventricular arrhythmia disease states: Emerging treatment options.
summary: Autonomic modulation has emerged as an effective therapeutic target in the management of ventricular arrhythmias and electrical storm (e.g., refractory ventricular arrhythmias), in a background of growing evidence of the link between the autonomic nervous system and arrhythmias. Stellate ganglion blockade (SGB) is a minimally invasive procedure targeting the stellate ganglion with an anesthetic agent that has emerged as a temporizing treatment option for management of refractory and hemodynamically unstable ventricular arrhythmias and electrical storm (ES). SGB which can be performed with fluoroscopy-guidance or at the bedside with anatomic landmark approach or ultrasound guidance, has shown potential efficacy in short-term reduction of arrhythmic burden and termination of electrical storm, based on data from case series and observational studies. In the current review, we highlight the role of the autonomic nervous system in arrhythmogenesis and the clinical applications as well as current limitations and future directions of SGB in management of ventricular arrhythmia and electrical storm.

AI.tldr: 该综述指出，星状神经节阻滞（SGB）作为一种微创自主神经调控手段，可短期减少难治性室性心律失常负荷并终止电风暴，但现有证据仅来自病例系列与观察性研究。
AI.motivation: 自主神经系统与室性心律失常的发生密切相关，自主神经调控已成为室性心律失常及电风暴（ES）治疗的新靶点。对于难治性、血流动力学不稳定的室性心律失常与电风暴，药物及导管消融治疗效果有限，临床亟需可快速实施的临时性辅助手段；SGB 在此背景下的应用价值、操作方式及证据强度尚缺乏系统梳理。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，非原始研究，摘要未报告样本量、纳入人群规模及具体检索策略。综述内容涵盖：自主神经在心律失常发生中的作用机制；SGB 的解剖学靶点（星状神经节）与操作方式，包括透视引导、床旁解剖标志法及超声引导；SGB 在难治性室性心律失常与电风暴中的临床应用、局限性及未来方向。证据来源为病例系列与观察性研究，摘要未报告终点定义细节与统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量结果，未提供样本量、效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值。根据所引病例系列与观察性研究的数据，SGB 在短期降低心律失常负荷和终止电风暴方面显示出潜在疗效；同时，SGB 可经透视引导、床旁解剖标志法或超声引导完成，属微创操作。综述亦指出当前存在局限性，但摘要未具体说明。
AI.conclusion: SGB 有望成为难治性室性心律失常与电风暴的一种微创、可床旁实施的临时性治疗选择，为等待药物调整或导管消融（如室速基质消融）争取时间窗。但现有证据级别较低，仅基于病例系列和观察性研究，缺乏随机对照试验验证其对硬终点（如死亡率、复发率）的影响，操作路径、麻醉药物与剂量、阻滞时长及疗效预测因素均待规范。临床实践中不宜将其作为替代性根治手段，需在电生理团队协作下个体化应用，并期待前瞻性对照研究明确其适应证与安全性。

title: Rapid Progression of Cardiac Allograft Vasculopathy With Sudden Cardiac Death Within the First Year of Heart Transplantation: A Case Report.
summary: Cardiac allograft vasculopathy (CAV) is a major cause of mortality and morbidity within the first 3 years of heart transplantation (HT). CAV results in progressive coronary artery stenosis and may lead to arrhythmias and sudden cardiac death. In some cases, sudden cardiac death represents the initial presentation of CAV, as cardiac denervation blunts anginal symptoms that otherwise could have preceded sudden cardiac death (SCD). Here, we describe the case of a 56-year-old man with non-ischemic cardiomyopathy. He underwent left ventricular assist device implantation followed by orthotopic HT. Five months after transplantation, he presented with atypical mid-sternal chest discomfort initially thought to be musculoskeletal in origin. Routine coronary angiography at 12 months revealed severe, diffuse 3-vessel disease consistent with International Society of Heart and Lung Transplantation (ISHLT) CAV-3, and cardiac MRI revealed full thickness delayed enhancement in the inferior wall consistent with infarction. Despite overall preserved left ventricular ejection fraction, he developed polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (VT) with an appropriate shock from a wearable cardioverter-defibrillator (WCD) and was transferred with an intra-aortic balloon pump to a larger transplant center and underwent another heart transplantation. This case highlights rapid CAV progression leading to infarction and arrhythmia despite preserved LVEF, emphasizing the need for enhanced screening with biomarkers and imaging as well as earlier consideration for device-based strategies to prevent sudden cardiac death in high-risk transplant recipients.

AI.tldr: 一例 56 岁男性原位心脏移植受者在术后 12 个月内快速进展为 ISHLT CAV-3 弥漫三支病变，并发生下壁梗死与多形性室速，尽管 LVEF 保留仍最终接受再次心脏移植。
AI.motivation: 心脏移植后 3 年内，心脏移植物血管病（CAV）是主要致死与致残原因。移植心脏去神经化使缺血性心绞痛症状被掩盖，室性心律失常乃至心脏性猝死（SCD）可能成为 CAV 的首发表现，因此临床上难以早期识别。现有的常规随访方案（症状加年度冠状动脉造影）是否足以发现快速进展型 CAV、以及高危受者是否需要更早采用器械预防 SCD，均缺乏明确证据，本研究以个案形式提出这一缺口。
AI.method: 单例病例报告（Transplant Proc），无对照组与统计分析。对象为 56 岁男性非缺血性心肌病病人，先后接受左心室辅助装置（LVAD）植入与原位心脏移植。描述术后 5 个月的临床表现、12 个月常规冠状动脉造影的 ISHLT CAV 分级、心脏 MRI 延迟强化、LVEF、可穿戴心律转复除颤器（WCD）记录、主动脉内球囊反搏（IABP）支持及再次心脏移植经过。摘要未报告统计方法与定量终点。
AI.result: 术后 5 个月出现非典型胸骨中段不适，初判为肌肉骨骼来源；术后 12 个月冠状动脉造影示严重弥漫性三支病变，符合 ISHLT CAV-3；心脏 MRI 示下壁全层延迟强化，符合心肌梗死。整体 LVEF 保留，但病人发生多形性室性心动过速（VT），WCD 给予恰当放电，随后在 IABP 支持下转入大型移植中心并接受再次心脏移植。摘要未报告具体 LVEF 数值、CAV 进展的影像时间序列及随访结局。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示，移植后 CAV 可在 LVEF 保留的情况下快速进展至梗死并诱发恶性室性心律失常，单纯依赖症状与年度造影可能漏诊。临床上应加强生物标志物与影像学的早期筛查，并对高危受者更早考虑 WCD/ICD 等器械策略以预防 SCD。局限性为单一病例报告，无法推断因果关系或推广筛查与器械指征，需更大样本的前瞻研究验证。

title: Seizures Secondary to Aconitum Plant Poisoning: a case report.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Aconitum plant poisoning typically manifests as isolated early cardiotoxicity or late neurotoxicity. However, the dynamic temporal evolution from arrhythmia-driven cardiogenic syncope to true epileptic seizures mediated by direct central nervous system injury remains rarely documented and poorly characterized.

CASE PRESENTATION: We report a 53-year-old Han Chinese male who presented with ventricular tachycardia rapidly degenerating into ventricular fibrillation and cardiac arrest following ingestion of homemade Aconitum kusnezoffii (caowu)-infused liquor. Initial convulsions were tightly coupled with malignant arrhythmias, consistent with cardiogenic syncope. After successful resuscitation, hemoperfusion, and restoration of stable sinus rhythm, the patient developed breakthrough generalized tonic-clonic seizures on hospital days 4-6. Electroencephalography performed during sedation withdrawal revealed bilateral occipital spike-and-slow and sharp-and-slow waves with focal epileptiform discharges, confirming direct central nervous system neurotoxicity rather than recurrent cardiac ischemia. A mechanism-based, staged treatment strategy was employed: early advanced cardiac life support and hemoperfusion targeted cardiotoxicity, while sodium valproate and acetylglutamine were administered for antiepileptic prophylaxis and neuroprotection. The patient was discharged on day 13; antiepileptic therapy was successfully tapered and discontinued at 3 months without seizure recurrence, with normalization of electroencephalography and electrocardiography.

CONCLUSIONS: This case provides the first systematic documentation, validated by electroencephalography, of the transition from cardiogenic convulsions to true epileptic seizures in Aconitum alkaloid poisoning. The findings highlight the critical role of pharmacokinetic-driven central nervous system retention in delayed seizure onset and underscore the necessity of prolonged neurological monitoring, early electroencephalography evaluation for late-onset convulsions, and sustained antiepileptic prophylaxis to reduce mortality and long-term neurological sequelae.

KEY CLINICAL MESSAGE: Aconitum plant poisoning may manifest as early cardiogenic syncope and convulsions secondary to malignant arrhythmias, progressing in the late stage to genuine seizures caused by central nervous system (CNS) injury. Effective management requires a staged treatment strategy targeting both cardiotoxicity and neurotoxicity, with a focus on stabilizing cardiac rhythm and providing neuroprotection as needed.

title: Pediatric restrictive cardiomyopathy with rapid complete atrioventricular block progression.
summary:
Restrictive cardiomyopathy (RCM) is a rare pediatric cardiomyopathy characterized by ventricular diastolic dysfunction, and poor prognosis that often requires heart transplantation. We report the case of a 7-year-old boy with RCM complicated by complete atrioventricular block (CAVB) in whom pathological examination of the explanted heart demonstrated extensive fibrosis involving the cardiac conduction system. At 1 year and 9 months of age, the patient presented with arrhythmia. Echocardiography revealed marked biatrial enlargement and small ventricles. Cardiac catheterization demonstrated elevated filling pressures confirming RCM. One month after diagnosis, the patient developed severe bradycardia and circulatory collapse, requiring extracorporeal membrane oxygenation. Electrocardiography revealed complete atrioventricular (AV) block, and a permanent pacemaker (PM) was implanted. Despite recurrent heart failure episodes, cardiac function was maintained with medical therapy, including carvedilol and enalapril, without mechanical circulatory support until heart transplantation at 5 years of age. Pathology of the explanted heart revealed extensive interstitial fibrosis involving the conduction system, suggesting that conduction tissue fibrosis caused the CAVB. These findings provide pathological insight into the mechanism of advanced atrioventricular block in pediatric RCM. This case demonstrates that RCM may progress from first-degree AV block to CAVB due to conduction fibrosis.

LEARNING OBJECTIVE: Understanding the clinical and pathological progression of restrictive cardiomyopathy (RCM) complicated by complete atrioventricular block in children is important. This case illustrates that fibrosis of the conduction system can lead to severe bradycardia and circulatory collapse, highlighting the importance of the early detection of conduction abnormalities and timely pacemaker implantation. It has also been demonstrated that appropriate medical therapy combined with pacemaker management can effectively bridge pediatric patients with RCM to heart transplantation.

title: A misleading wide-complex rhythm in an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator recipient.
External validation of artificial intelligence-guided electrocardiogram (AI-ECG) in detecting asymptomatic left ventricular dysfunction: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
summary:
AIM: Asymptomatic left ventricular dysfunction (LVD) represents a key and frequently under-recognized stage in the heart failure (HF) continuum. Early identification enables targeted prevention and timely initiation of evidence-based therapies. Artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiography (AI-ECG) may provide a scalable alternative to imaging for LVD detection. This systematic review synthesized evidence from exclusively externally validated AI-ECG studies evaluating the detection of asymptomatic LVD, with symptomatic HF cohorts included to contextualize the evidence base across the HF continuum.

METHODS: A systematic literature search was conducted on 8th September 2025. The main output was the pooled area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC).

RESULTS: From 3,587 records, 12 asymptomatic and 30 symptomatic studies were identified (538,735 participants). In asymptomatic cohorts evaluating left ventricular systolic dysfunction (LVSD), AI-ECG demonstrated promising but heterogeneous discriminatory performance (I²>85%) with pooled AUROCs of 0.87 (95% CI 0.75-0.99) for LVEF ≤35%, 0.93 (95% CI 0.88-0.97) for LVEF ≤40%, and 0.89 (95% CI 0.85-0.97) for LVEF ≤50%. Symptomatic cohorts showed AUROCs of 0.89 (95% CI 0.86-0.92), 0.90 (95% CI 0.88-0.92), and 0.85 (95% CI 0.83-0.86) respectively. Asymptomatic left ventricular diastolic dysfunction (LVDD) demonstrated moderate performance (AUROC 0.76, 95% CI 0.66-0.86) with no externally validated symptomatic LVDD studies identified. Small-study effects were detected exclusively in asymptomatic cohorts.

CONCLUSIONS: Discriminatory performance of AI-ECG in asymptomatic LVSD is broadly comparable to symptomatic populations. High risk of bias driven by prolonged ECG-to-echocardiogram intervals reflecting real-world logistical constraints necessitate cautious interpretation of results and further prospective validation.

AI.tldr: 在仅纳入外部验证研究的荟萃分析中，AI-ECG 识别无症状左室收缩功能不全的合并 AUROC 为 0.87–0.93，与有症状心衰人群（0.85–0.90）大致相当，但研究间异质性高、偏倚风险偏高。
AI.motivation: 无症状左室功能不全（LVD）是心衰连续病程中常被漏诊的关键阶段，早期识别可及时启动循证治疗与针对性预防。影像学筛查的可扩展性有限，AI-ECG 有望成为替代手段；但既往证据多来自内部验证，缺乏对仅经外部验证研究的系统汇总，尤其缺乏对无症状人群与有症状心衰人群的对比评估。
AI.method: 系统性综述与荟萃分析，检索截至 2025 年 9 月 8 日，共筛出 3,587 条记录。最终纳入 12 项无症状和 30 项有症状研究，合计 538,735 名受试者；纳入标准限定为经外部验证的 AI-ECG 检测 LVD 研究。主要结局指标为合并的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC），按 LVEF ≤35%、≤40%、≤50% 的收缩功能不全阈值，以及左室舒张功能不全（LVDD）分层；并进行异质性（I²）评估与小样本效应检验。
AI.result: 无症状队列检测 LVSD 的合并 AUROC 分别为：LVEF ≤35% 为 0.87（95%CI 0.75–0.99）、LVEF ≤40% 为 0.93（95%CI 0.88–0.97）、LVEF ≤50% 为 0.89（95%CI 0.85–0.97），异质性显著（I²>85%）。有症状队列对应为 0.89（95%CI 0.86–0.92）、0.90（95%CI 0.88–0.92）、0.85（95%CI 0.83–0.86）。无症状 LVDD 的判别效能中等（AUROC 0.76，95%CI 0.66–0.86），未检索到经外部验证的有症状 LVDD 研究。小样本效应仅见于无症状队列。
AI.conclusion: AI-ECG 对无症状左室收缩功能不全的判别效能与有症状人群大致相当，支持其作为可扩展的无症状 LVD 筛查工具的潜力。但心电图与超声心动图检查间隔过长（反映现实流程限制）导致偏倚风险高，且异质性突出，结果需谨慎解读，仍需前瞻性外部验证并规范检测时间窗。摘要未报告灵敏度、特异度等阈值依赖指标。

Structured postmortem genetic counselling and testing in sudden unexplained death among young adults in the Netherlands: results and implications regarding hereditary risk.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Sudden unexplained death (SUD) in young adults may result from hereditary cardiovascular disorders that remain undetected even after conventional autopsy. Routine postmortem genetic testing may identify these disorders, improving determination of the cause of death while providing diagnostic and preventive opportunities for surviving blood relatives.

METHODS: Between September 2022 and October 2025, 100 cases of SUD in young adults in the Netherlands were investigated using the NODOV (Nader Onderzoek naar de DoodsOorzaak bij (jong)Volwassenen) procedure. Genetic counselling was offered to surviving blood relatives in 50 cases where conventional autopsy findings suggested an inherited cardiovascular disorder. Conventional autopsy findings, medical history and family history guided phenotype-directed genetic testing using targeted gene panel analysis following whole-exome/genome sequencing.

RESULTS: Genetic testing was successfully performed in 46 out of 50 cases and identified pathogenic variants in six cases involving the CACNA1C, BAG3, MYBPC3, LDL-R, KCNJ2, and PKD1 genes. Pretest genetic counselling proved important in guiding genetic testing in 10% of all cases and 50% of genetically confirmed cases. Pathogenic variants were identified in both structurally abnormal and autopsy-negative cases. Families received tailored genetic counselling and recommendations for clinical follow-up based on predictive genetic testing. Among the 44 families without a genetic diagnosis, 43 were advised to undergo clinical cardiovascular screening.

CONCLUSION: This study highlights the importance of a structured multidisciplinary postmortem investigation, such as the NODOV procedure, integrating pretest genetic counselling and tailored postmortem genetic testing. This approach may improve determination of cause of death (particularly in autopsy-negative cases), aid in the identification of hereditary cardiovascular disorders and facilitate preventive strategies for at-risk blood relatives.

AI.tldr: 荷兰 NODOV 多学科流程对 100 例年轻成人不明原因猝死（SUD）开展尸检后遗传咨询与检测，50 例中 46 例完成检测，6 例（13%）检出致病性变异，涉及 CACNA1C、BAG3、MYBPC3、LDL-R、KCNJ2、PKD1。
AI.motivation: 年轻成人不明原因猝死常由常规尸检难以识别的遗传性心血管疾病所致，包括离子通道病与心肌病。既往缺乏将检测前遗传咨询、表型导向的尸检后基因检测与家属随访整合起来的规范化流程证据，导致死亡原因判定不清、幸存血亲的遗传风险被漏检，预防性干预机会流失。
AI.method: 单国前瞻性队列（荷兰，2022 年 9 月至 2025 年 10 月），按 NODOV 流程纳入 100 例年轻成人 SUD。对常规尸检提示遗传性心血管疾病的 50 例，向幸存血亲提供遗传咨询；结合尸检所见、病史与家族史进行表型导向检测，先行全外显子/全基因组测序，再行靶向基因 panel 分析。主要观察指标为致病性变异检出率及检测前咨询对检测策略的影响；摘要未报告具体终点定义细节与统计方法。
AI.result: 50 例中 46 例成功完成基因检测，6 例检出致病性变异，基因分别为 CACNA1C、BAG3、MYBPC3、LDL-R、KCNJ2、PKD1；变异既见于结构异常病例，也见于尸检阴性病例。检测前遗传咨询对全部病例中 10%、对遗传学确诊病例中 50% 的检测策略起到关键指导作用。确诊家系据预测性基因检测获得个体化咨询与临床随访建议；44 个未获基因诊断的家系中 43 个被建议接受临床心血管筛查。摘要未报告效应量、95%CI 与 P 值。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的多学科尸检后调查流程（NODOV）整合检测前遗传咨询与表型导向的尸检后基因检测，可提高死亡原因判定率（尤其在尸检阴性病例）、识别遗传性心血管疾病并为高危血亲提供预防路径，对心电生理与遗传门诊协作具有示范意义。局限在于样本量小、为单国观察性设计、无对照与统计学效应估计，检出率与临床结局的长期获益尚待更大规模随访验证。

title: Optogenetic cardioversion: To depolarize or to hyperpolarize?
Channelrhodopsin ion selectivity determines mechanisms and efficacy of optogenetic defibrillation in human atria and ventricles.
summary: Cardiac re-entrant arrhythmias are a major cause of sudden cardiac death. Optogenetic defibrillation has emerged as a promising anti-arrhythmic strategy based on photoactivation of channelrhodopsins, yet the efficacy and potential adverse consequences of activating different classes of light-gated ion channels have not been systematically evaluated. Previous studies assessed either cation (e.g. ChR2) or anion (e.g. GtACR1) non-selective channels, both of which depolarize resting cardiomyocytes. Recently identified light-gated K+ channels (e.g. WiChR) suppress cardiomyocyte activity while maintaining the membrane potential near its resting state, but their defibrillation potential remains unexplored. We used computational simulations to compare ChR2, GtACR1 and WiChR. Single-cell simulations showed that ChR2 and GtACR1 markedly increased diastolic intracellular Ca2+ (by 42.6% and 52.6%, respectively), whereas WiChR induced only minimal changes (by 4.0%), suggesting lower pro-arrhythmogenic risk. WiChR, however, slightly increased intracellular Na+ (by 15.1% vs. 0.1% and 3.4% for ChR2 and GtACR1), consistent with the residual Na+ permeability of currently available K+-conducting channelrhodopsins. Simulations in human ventricles and atria showed that GtACR1 most effectively terminated re-entrant arrhythmias at low light intensities, whereas WiChR achieved comparable efficacy at ≥5 mW/mm2. Complementary tissue-scale simulations revealed that defibrillation occurs through depolarization within the excitable gap followed by fast Na+ channel inactivation (ChR2 and partly GtACR1), or through reduced membrane resistance at sufficiently high light intensities (large-conductance channels GtACR1 and WiChR). Overall, we demonstrate that channelrhodopsin ion selectivity is a key determinant of both optogenetic defibrillation efficacy and its underlying mechanisms. TRANSLATIONAL PERSPECTIVE: Re-entrant arrhythmias are a leading cause of sudden cardiac death. Standard therapies, including the activation of implantable cardioverter-defibrillators, carry burdens such as pain and myocardial injury. Optogenetic defibrillation has been suggested as a potentially gentler alternative, replacing high-voltage electrical shocks by photoactivation of light-gated ion channels expressed in cardiac cells. Determining which light-gated ion channel optimally balances efficacy and adverse effects on cardiac electrophysiology is critical for clinical translation. We addressed this question using computational simulations and validation experiments in zebrafish hearts. We identify ion selectivity as a key determinant of both the success rate for arrhythmia termination and the underlying mechanisms: non-selective cation- and anion-conducting channels terminate re-entry efficiently while promoting intracellular Ca2+ accumulation, a plausible substrate for pro-arrhythmic side effects that could undermine therapeutic safety. K+-conducting channels largely avoid this pro-arrhythmic risk by holding cardiomyocytes near their resting potential, albeit at the cost of requiring transmural illumination, while also causing mild Na+ accumulation attributable to residual Na+ permeability. Together, these trade-offs define clear clinical implications: K+-conducting channels may provide the safest option for optogenetic defibrillation, particularly once variants with further enhanced K+ selectivity and red-shifted activation spectra for improved operation within blood-perfused myocardium become available. KEY POINTS: We use computational simulations to compare cation non-selective (ChR2), anion non-selective (GtACR1) and K+-selective (WiChR) channelrhodopsins for optogenetic termination of re-entrant arrhythmia. Single-cardiomyocyte simulations suggest that ChR2 and GtACR1 activation can cause progressive accumulation of intracellular Ca2+, which is minimized when using WiChR. Intracellular microelectrode recordings from hearts of transgenic adult zebrafish validate the simulated voltage dynamics seen with ChR2, GtACR1 or WiChR activation. Simulations of human left ventricles and atria indicate that GtACR1 is most effective in terminating re-entrant arrhythmia at low light intensities, whereas WiChR becomes similarly effective at higher intensities. Tissue-scale simulations indicate distinct defibrillation mechanisms: excitable gap extinction by de novo action potential initiation followed by inactivation of fast Na+ channels for depolarizing channelrhodopsins (ChR2, GtACR1), and reduction in membrane resistance for the large-conductance channels (GtACR1, WiChR), effectively clamping the membrane potential at each channel's reversal potential at high light levels.

AI.tldr: 计算模拟比较三种光敏通道蛋白发现，离子选择性决定光遗传学除颤的疗效与机制：GtACR1 低光强下终止折返最有效，K+ 选择性 WiChR 在 ≥5 mW/mm² 时疗效相当且钙超载风险最低。
AI.motivation: 折返性心律失常是心源性猝死的主要原因，ICD 放电带来疼痛与心肌损伤，光遗传学除颤被视为更温和的替代方案。既往研究仅评估了阳离子型（如 ChR2）与阴离子型（如 GtACR1）非选择性光门控通道，二者均使静息心肌细胞去极化，促心律失常风险不明；新发现的 K+ 选择性光门控通道（如 WiChR）在抑制心肌活动的同时维持膜电位接近静息水平，但其除颤潜力从未被系统评估，不同通道类别之间的疗效与安全性权衡缺乏证据。
AI.method: 本研究为计算模拟研究，并以转基因成年斑马鱼心脏细胞内微电极记录作为验证。构建单心肌细胞、人心房与心室组织及组织尺度模型，比较三类通道蛋白：阳离子非选择性 ChR2、阴离子非选择性 GtACR1、K+ 选择性 WiChR。评估指标包括舒张期细胞内 Ca2+ 与 Na+ 浓度变化、不同光照强度（含 ≥5 mW/mm2）下折返性心律失常的终止率，以及除颤的膜电生理机制（可兴奋间隙内去极化后快 Na+ 通道失活、膜电阻降低）。摘要未报告具体样本量与统计检验方法。
AI.result: 单细胞模拟显示，ChR2 与 GtACR1 使舒张期细胞内 Ca2+ 分别升高 42.6% 与 52.6%，WiChR 仅升高 4.0%，提示促心律失常风险更低；但 WiChR 使细胞内 Na+ 升高 15.1%，而 ChR2 与 GtACR1 分别为 0.1% 与 3.4%，与现有 K+ 导通通道蛋白残余 Na+ 通透性一致。人心室与心房模拟中，GtACR1 在低光强下终止折返最有效，WiChR 在 ≥5 mW/mm2 时达到相当疗效。组织尺度模拟提示机制不同：ChR2 及部分 GtACR1 通过在可兴奋间隙内启动新动作电位继而快 Na+ 通道失活实现除颤；大电导通道（GtACR1、WiChR）在高光强下通过降低膜电阻、将膜电位钳制于各通道反转电位而起效。斑马鱼心脏微电极记录验证了三种通道激活时的模拟电压动态。
AI.conclusion: 光敏通道蛋白的离子选择性是光遗传学除颤疗效及其机制的关键决定因素：非选择性阳离子与阴离子通道终止折返效率高，但促进细胞内 Ca2+ 蓄积，构成潜在促心律失常安全隐患；K+ 导通通道基本规避该风险，代价是需要透壁光照并伴轻度 Na+ 蓄积。就临床转化而言，K+ 选择性通道可能是最安全的光遗传学除颤选择，未来若获得 K+ 选择性更强、激活光谱红移（利于血液灌注心肌内操作）的变体将更具前景。局限性在于结论主要来自计算模拟与斑马鱼验证，尚缺乏人体在体验证，最佳光强与安全性需进一步实验确认。

title: Pathogenic Variants in NKX2-5 Associated With Familial Atrial Septal Defect and Conduction System Disease.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Most atrial septal defects (ASDs) occur sporadically, but familial cases can occur and carry a 10% risk of transmission to offspring.

CASE SUMMARY: We describe a 3-generation family with autosomal dominant secundum ASD and conduction system disease related to a novel NKX2-5 variant (c.300del; p.Asp101Thrfs∗75). The index patient, a 58-year-old woman with prior ASD repair and mitral valve replacement, presented with chronotropic incompetence, atrial fibrillation, left bundle branch block, and prolonged pauses, leading to pacemaker implantation. Her mother had an ASD, atrial fibrillation, left bundle branch block, and pulmonary arterial hypertension. The proband's daughter also had an ASD. Genetic testing revealed a novel NKX2-5 pathogenic variant in all 3 patients.

REVIEW SUMMARY: The combination of an ASD and conduction system disease represents the most common phenotype in patients with pathogenic NKX2-5 variants.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGE: A thorough family history and genetic testing are needed when evaluating patients with ASD and concurrent conduction system abnormalities.

AI.tldr: 本病例报告描述一个三代常染色体显性遗传家系，携带新型 NKX2-5 致病变异（c.300del; p.Asp101Thrfs*75），表现为继发孔型房间隔缺损合并传导系统疾病，提示 ASD 合并传导异常时应追问家族史并进行基因检测。
AI.motivation: 多数房间隔缺损（ASD）为散发病例，但家族性病例确实存在，且传给子代的风险约为 10%；临床对 ASD 合并传导系统异常患者的遗传学病因识别不足，既往对 NKX2-5 变异相关家系的表型谱与家系筛查路径报告有限。
AI.method: 本研究为单家系病例报告并附文献综述：描述一个三代家系，先证者为 58 岁女性，既往曾接受 ASD 修补术和二尖瓣置换术；收集其母亲与女儿的表型资料，并对 3 例患者进行基因检测，以识别致病变异及家系共分离情况。摘要未报告样本量以外的统计学方法与随访时长。
AI.result: 3 例患者均检出同一新型 NKX2-5 致病变异 c.300del（p.Asp101Thrfs*75），家系呈常染色体显性遗传。先证者表现为变时性功能不全、心房颤动、左束支传导阻滞及长间歇，最终植入起搏器；其母亲有 ASD、心房颤动、左束支传导阻滞和肺动脉高压；其女儿亦有 ASD。摘要未报告基因变异的致病性评级细节及具体随访数据。
AI.conclusion: ASD 合并传导系统疾病是 NKX2-5 致病变异患者最常见的表型组合；对这类患者应详细采集家族史并开展基因检测，以实现家系级联筛查与早期识别传导阻滞、心律失常风险。局限性为单一小样本家系报告，结论的外推性有限，且摘要未报告基因型与表型的定量关联。

title: Successful extravascular implantable cardioverter-defibrillator implantation in a patient with short QT syndrome: A case report.
summary:
Short QT syndrome (SQTS) can present with life-threatening ventricular fibrillation (VF), requiring timely resuscitation and secondary prevention. A male patient in his 20s was resuscitated from VF and diagnosed with SQTS. Genetic testing may identify rare variants, such as in SLC4A3, expanding the known genetic spectrum of SQTS. Tall T waves may cause subcutaneous implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (S-ICD) screening failure in some vectors, highlighting limitations of S-ICDs in certain SQTS patients. Extravascular ICD implantation can be a feasible and effective option for patients with SQTS when transvenous or subcutaneous ICDs are suboptimal.

LEARNING OBJECTIVES: Short QT syndrome (SQTS) can present with life-threatening ventricular fibrillation, requiring timely resuscitation and secondary prevention.Genetic testing may identify rare variants, such as in SLC4A3, expanding the known genetic spectrum of SQTS.Tall T waves may cause subcutaneous implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (S-ICD) screening failure in some vectors, highlighting limitations of S-ICDs in certain SQTS patients.Extravascular ICD implantation can be a feasible and effective option for patients with SQTS when transvenous or subcutaneous ICDs are suboptimal.

AI.tldr: 一例20余岁男性短QT综合征患者经VF复苏后，因高T波致S-ICD筛查失败，最终成功植入血管外ICD。
AI.motivation: 短QT综合征可导致危及生命的室性颤动，需要及时复苏和二级预防。经静脉ICD和皮下ICD在部分患者中受限，尤其是高T波可导致S-ICD筛查失败；同时SQTS的遗传谱仍待拓展，SLC4A3等罕见变异值得关注。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。患者为20余岁男性，室性颤动复苏后诊断为短QT综合征；接受基因检测，并评估ICD植入策略，包括S-ICD筛查及血管外ICD植入可行性。主要观察器械植入是否成功及S-ICD筛查结果。摘要未报告统计方法、正式终点定义及随访数据。
AI.result: 患者室性颤动复苏后确诊短QT综合征。摘要提及基因检测可能发现SLC4A3等罕见变异，但未报告本例具体变异位点及阳性细节。因高T波导致S-ICD部分向量筛查失败，最终成功植入血管外ICD。摘要未报告随访、除颤阈值、并发症及统计检验结果。
AI.conclusion: 对于短QT综合征需二级预防、且经静脉或皮下ICD不适用者，血管外ICD可作为可行且有效的选择；高T波可造成S-ICD筛查失败，器械选择应个体化。结论受单例报告限制，长期有效性与安全性尚未明确。
